text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!! Incredible, it is so 
incredible---!!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "To get so many! You're really talented!"

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna post photos of these guys on 
Umatter! My followers are gonna flip out!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Mmh, that's it! You should get in the 
photo with the Paka Puchi too!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who caught these guys! 
Rewarding my minions is part of an evil 
king's duty!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wahahahahaha! Keep on working for the 
Demon Kingー!
